$comment: QA-07 shared contract vectors — single source of truth for the four client packages (acf-cli, mcp-server, autocodeflow-node-sdk, autoflow-sdk). Envelope source: apps/admin-api/src/common/interceptors/response.interceptor.ts. Vectors are append-only (published clients assert on old vectors); changing behavior is a breaking contract change -> bump $schemaVersion and ship all four ends together. See README.md for the full contract description and consumption instructions. $schemaVersion 1 -> 2 (2026-10-14, A-11R): the params->env serialization semantics changed (strings are injected bare again instead of JSON-quoted; a typed AUTOFLOW_PARAMS_JSON channel was added) — see executorEnvSerializationV2, which supersedes the now-frozen executorEnvSerialization archive. The envelope contract itself is unchanged.

non200SuccessCode.$comment: code mirrors HTTP status; 201 must unwrap exactly like 200

emptyObject.$comment: no data key at all -> not an envelope

arrayBody.$comment: arrays are never envelopes (node-sdk rule; py dict-guard equivalent)

stringCodeEnvelope.$comment: PK-06 unification (2026-09-14, all four ends): the envelope code is always numeric (ResponseInterceptor statusCode ?? 200) — a STRING code is not an envelope. A payload carrying code+message+data with a string code is a business body and must pass through unchanged. Append-only vector pinning the unified 'data key present + numeric code' criterion

statusRange.$comment: anything in success[] must resolve; anything in failure[] must throw/inspect body — no status-specific bypass

errorBody.name: envelope-style single message

raw.message: Invalid or expired execution callback token

errorBody.detail: Invalid or expired execution callback token

errorBody.name: class-validator message array

message: status must be one of the following values

errorBody.detail: executionId must be a UUID; status must be one of the following values

errorBody.name: no detail at all
errorBody.$comment: empty detail -> callers must keep raw status/text, never swallow

knownHeuristicEdge.name: code+message+data on an entity payload (full envelope shape)
knownHeuristicEdge.$comment: documented edge: a payload carrying the FULL envelope shape (code+message+data) is indistinguishable from an envelope and is unwrapped by every end — entities must never carry all three keys. Unified criterion since PK-06 (2026-09-14, all four ends): 'data key present + numeric code' (message no longer tested; string code passes through — see passthrough.stringCodeEnvelope); changing it is a breaking contract change

knownDivergence.name: data+message WITHOUT code
knownDivergence.$comment: 2026-09-14 (PK-06/PK-07 unification, all four ends): cli/mcp tightened to the numeric-code criterion (2026-09-13, WIKI-OPT-4) and node-sdk/py-sdk now match — the envelope test everywhere is 'data key present + code is a number', so this payload (no code key at all) is preserved unchanged by EVERY end. The cli_mcp_unwrapped key above is a historical archive of the pre-2026-09-13 loose heuristic and no longer describes any shipped client. Divergence is closed; see passthrough.stringCodeEnvelope for the pinned string-code vector

channelList.$comment: A4 (DEEP_REVIEW 0ef3bbe): canonical set of notification channel ids. Source of truth in admin-api is the AlertChannel enum (apps/admin-api/src/modules/notification/notification.service.ts); the six channel classes under channels/*.channel.ts each declare their own "name" and admin-web's AlarmConfig carries yet another hand-written option list. Three independent copies drifted: feishu existed in the enum and in NotificationSettingsPage but was MISSING from AlarmConfig's selector (a real defect found while landing this section). This vector pins all copies to one set.

executorEnvSerialization.$comment: A-11 (2026-10-02, executor-node + executor-python): task `params` values injected into the child env as AUTOFLOW_<KEY> must be serialized as JSON on BOTH executors — node JSON.stringify(v), python json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')) (ensure_ascii=False matches JSON.stringify's raw UTF-8 output; compact separators make objects/arrays byte-identical). Previously node String(v) / python str(v) produced different bytes for the same dispatch payload (True vs 'true', None vs 'null', "['a']" vs '["a"]'), so the same task read different AUTOFLOW_* values per executor. Append-only vectors; each `env` value is the exact string both executors must produce. ⚠️ HISTORICAL ARCHIVE as of A-11R (2026-10-14): this section pins the OLD semantics in which STRINGS WERE ALSO QUOTED (`"hello"`). That quoting is exactly the production regression A-11R repairs — the admin console's ParamsEditor contract is Record<string,string>, so every UI-configured param gained a pair of quotes and scripts reading per the official docs (int(os.environ['AUTOFLOW_LIMIT'])) broke with ValueError (production: tk-ship-notify silently dead for 12 days). The live semantics are pinned in `executorEnvSerializationV2` below; these vectors stay frozen per the append-only rule (published clients asserted on them) and are no longer asserted against the implementation.

executorEnvSerializationV2.$comment: A-11R (2026-10-14, executor-node + executor-python): the LIVE params→env semantics, superseding executorEnvSerialization (kept above as a frozen historical archive). Two channels coexist. ① Per-key channel `AUTOFLOW_<KEY>`: STRINGS ARE INJECTED BARE (no quotes) — restoring the pre-A-11 behaviour for strings, because the admin console (ParamsEditor) can only produce strings, so A-11's uniform JSON.stringify broke every UI-configured parameter and every script following the official docs. Non-strings (bool / number / null / array / object) stay JSON, preserving A-11's genuine fix for the node String(v) vs python str(v) drift. ② Typed channel `AUTOFLOW_PARAMS_JSON` (paramsJsonVectors below): the whole params object as one compact JSON document, injected after the per-key loop so user params cannot override it; absent when params is empty/null. It exists because the per-key channel's values are always strings and therefore CANNOT express the difference between the string "true" and the boolean true. Byte parity is now a fact rather than a claim: python no longer uses json.dumps (whose float layout differs from JSON.stringify — 1e-7 rendered as '1e-07', 0.00001 as '1e-05', and whose object key order is plain insertion order) but implements JSON.stringify's own rules in apps/executor-python/js_json.py; the float-exponent, large-integer and integer-key-order vectors below are the cases the original 10-vector set missed. Append-only: each `env` is the exact string BOTH executors must produce. Consumers: apps/executor-node/src/param-env.ts, apps/executor-python/js_json.py + routers/execute.py (_serialize_param_value / _serialize_params_json), asserted from both executors' test suites.

executorLogLineSplitting.$comment:
A-LOG (2026-10-05, executor-node + executor-python): GET /logs/{executionId} 的行切分语义——同一段日志**原始字节**必须在两端产出逐行相同的 lines[]。node pageLogLines (routes/logs.ts, readline) 与 python get_execution_logs (routers/logs.py, 文本模式逐行迭代 + rstrip('
')) 必须对同一文件给出同一分页。共同语义：按 '
' 切行并剥行尾 '
'（CRLF 输出与 LF 输出同判）；空行是合法行（保留）；文件末尾无换行符时最后一行照常成行；空文件零行。⚠️ 已知边界（刻意不入向量）：行中间的孤立 ''（旧 Mac 风格）python 的 universal-newlines 文本模式会切分、node readline 保留在行内容里——真实日志由执行器 file-logger 以 '
' 写出、Windows 任务输出的 '
' 两侧同剥，该形态不可达，收进向量反而要改一端运行时。协议层的响应形状（{lines,totalLines,hasMore}）另见 executor-protocol/protocol.json 的 LogsResponse schemaVectors——两份各管一层。Append-only vectors；每条 `lines` 是两端实现必须产出的精确行数组。

vectors.name: crlf-terminated
vectors.$comment: Windows 任务输出恒为 CRLF——行尾 \r\n 必须被剥成与 LF 相同的内容，否则同一任务在两端的日志页逐字节不同。

vectors.name: unicode-raw-utf8
vectors.$comment: 与 executorEnvSerialization 的中文先例同源：两端都按 UTF-8 解码（python errors='replace'），非 ASCII 行内容不得变形。

vectors.name: empty-output
vectors.$comment: 空文件 → lines:[] 且 totalLines:0（readline 无 line 事件 / 文本迭代零轮）——admin 回填分页以此为终止条件。
